_readme: Frozen scoring eval set. Each case is a real posting as it was scored (many were title-only backfills — descriptions reflect that), the correct band per owner feedback, and the reason. Every issue cited by a feedback.md rule must be covered by a case citing that issue (enforced per-issue by eval_runner, no grandfathering). Pass = exact band; adjacent band = warn; >=2 bands off, or any top/misfit confusion = fail. owner_verified=false means the label was derived (from prior model output or rubric intent), not confirmed by the owner — treat failures on those as questions, not regressions.

cases.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Infrastructure (Storage)
cases.description: s, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. About This Role Crusoe is building the infrastructure layer that powers the most demanding AI workloads on the planet. Our storage stack is what keeps tens of thousands of GPUs fed with data, whether that means block volumes for fast bootups, a shared file system for a training cluster, or the object storage tier a physical AI customer depends on. As a Staff Product Manager on our Cloud Infrastructure team, you will own the storage product roadmap and shape how customers experience capacity, durability, and ease of use. This is a customer-obsessed role. You will spend real time with the engineers and infrastructure teams building on Crusoe Cloud, understand what is slowing them down or holding them back, and translate that into a product strategy that wins more of our business. You will work closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Software Engineering, SRE, Finance, and our executive team to turn customer insight into a storage platform that is easier to build on and better matched to how our customers actually use it.
